accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 / Theorem 2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The graph-uniform analytic homotopy and hence the stable-orbit realization remain an explicit open solve target; finite gadget checks do not establish it.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The counting separation and field-tier assessment are conditional on favorable resolution of the analytic-homotopy and stable-orbit-realization targets.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: LiNG-D enumerates zeroless-diagonal row permutations, normalizes rows, and outputs the distribution-entailment equivalence class under the stated ICA conditions.
The paper identifies cyclic LiNG equivalence classes with bipartite perfect matchings and proves SCC invariance across distribution-equivalent graphs.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1005.5584 preprint corroborating the FOCS 2010 result
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Unless NP=RP, no FPRAS counts independent sets on graphs of maximum degree at most six.
Counting independent sets remains #P-complete on 3-regular graphs.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Under bounded eighth moments and strictly ordered distinct kurtoses, FOBI has a root-n expansion and joint multivariate-normal limit.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a worked exact rational instance for a smallest nontrivial graph, displaying every admissible permutation and its stability certificate; this would make the realization construction auditable before the uniform homotopy proof.
State a corollary isolating a concrete bounded-SCC or bounded-treewidth regime where the SCC product formula gives a practically usable exact stable-count procedure.

Develop a locally uniform inference extension under explicit kurtosis-gap, normalization, and unit-circle separation margins, distinguishing it sharply from the current pointwise confidence-image result.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the analytic-homotopy realization as the primary solve target and retain all complexity conclusions as conditional downstream consequences.
